A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same OptiScene framework and 3D-SynthPlace dataset. All 24 pages of each version, including equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–E, support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original layout-generation experiments, human usability evaluations, editing and navigation results, and ablations in Section 4, with additional examples in the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experimental results in Section 4 and the appendices, including generation benchmarks, downstream tasks, and ablations.

M1.justification: The asset-retrieval pipeline, semantic-reasoning SFT, two-stage DPO, and layout generation and editing procedures remain unchanged. Sections 3 and Appendices B–C describe the same components and objectives.

E1.justification: Both versions use 3D-Front and 3D-SynthPlace with the same bedroom, living-room, kitchen, and bathroom coverage. Scene editing and object-centric navigation tasks are retained without new evaluation scenarios.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain I-Design, DiffuScene, LLplace, their existing training variants, and Holodeck. Table 5 retains the same navigation backends. The newly cited works are not evaluated as baselines.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 retains the same data splits, Qwen3-8B model, training schedules, and evaluation metrics. Human-rating procedures, 20 editing cases, and navigation success criteria also remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Table 6 retains the same reasoning and DPO-stage ablations, and Figure 7 retains the semantic-description versus scene-graph comparison. Appendix dataset analyses, error examples, and qualitative case studies are unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged, including the descriptive dataset summaries. Neither version reports multi-seed uncertainty, confidence intervals, or formal significance tests.

E6.justification: Tables 1–6 retain the same numerical entries, and the main-text and appendix result figures retain the same examples and findings. For example, OptiScene's 3D-Front bedroom FID/OOR remains 33.56/0.03, and editing success remains 90%.

T1.justification: The layout formulation, generation equations, DPO objective, and Appendix D.2 overlap-rate definition are mathematically unchanged. No assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: 3D-SynthPlace, reasoning-guided SFT with two-stage DPO, improved layout generation, and applicability to editing and navigation.

C2.justification: Interpretations of semantic reasoning, preference alignment, and geometric plausibility are unchanged. Appendix E retains the same limitations concerning single-room generation and missing small-object and wall-object coverage.

D1.justification: Training hyperparameters, GPU-hour reporting, coordinate alignment, Isaac Sim rendering, and prompt templates in Tables 7–9 are unchanged. Both abstracts still state that the dataset and code will be released soon.

R1.justification: v2 adds three background references: 3D-MORE, A0, and NaVid, cited in the introduction and listed as references 34, 35, and 41. The discussion of competing approaches and the paper's novelty positioning otherwise remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 adds the Spatialtemporal AI affiliation and updates author affiliation superscripts. Citation numbering changes accordingly, while the substantive prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The added affiliation shifts Figure 1 and the abstract downward, and opening text reflows across pages, including the closing related-work paragraph moving to page 4. The bibliography expands, but figure and table content, designs, and captions remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 adds three contextual citations and updates affiliations, with minor layout reflow. The scientific argument, experimental evidence, reproducibility information, and limitations remain unchanged throughout the main text and appendices; these edits produce no meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
